faq: Do I need an Etsy account first?

Not if you tick the start-from-scratch box. You open the account yourself, because Etsy needs your identity and bank details, and we guide each step. Then you add us as a shop manager and we do the rest.
Can you enter my bank details?
No. You type bank, tax and identity details yourself, because they are private and Etsy verifies them. We walk you through where each item goes and check the rest of the settings.
Will you choose my shop name?
We give you a shortlist of names that read well, are short and look free to use as an Etsy name. You choose. We also point out if a name looks close to a registered brand.
Etsy charges you directly: a listing fee for each item, a transaction fee on sales and a payment processing fee. Our price is for the setup work only, and we explain each fee on the checklist.
